nurse.text: Hello, dear! Welcome to Oxford Sanctuary, which is not part of the University, whatever the hat on the door says. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit down. We've tea, and Oxford marmalade on toast, which I'm told is the right way round.
There we are. Right as rain, and the rain here comes with its own spire.
The Ark is in the corner, by the bookcase. It's been on the waiting list for a book since 1987.

else.text: No hurry. Mind the cyclists on the way out; they have the right of way and the right of way knows it.
